expectations.text: New driver file exists under drivers/
Calls run_opt/main from run_continuous in a loop rather than reimplementing the training loop
expectations.evidence: from jlab_opt_control.drivers.run_continuous import run_opt; calls it once per seed inside run_seed_sweep().

expectations.text: Defines its own argparse CLI (seeds, agent id, env id, episodes, shared logdir root)
expectations.evidence: argparse mirrors run_continuous.py's full flag surface plus --nseeds/--seed_start/--seeds.

expectations.text: Produces one subfolder per seed under a shared logdir root, consistent with run_continuous.py's directory naming
